newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields:6-mo up,9-mo same,12-mo down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields:6-mo up,9-mo same,12-mo down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month Ukraine discount treasury bills rose, yields on nine-month bills were unchanged and 12-month bills slipped from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Six-month bills rose to 20.13 percent from 20.00 percent, nine-month bills remained at 28.13 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 30.46 percent from 30.75 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 13.62 million UAH 14.33 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.38 million UAH 13.03 million UAH
The central bank sold 136,247 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 17.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Amount sold 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 31.39 million UAH 31.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 380,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 17.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 60.00 million UAH 60.00 million UAH
Amount sold 60.00 million UAH 60.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 46.02 million UAH 45.92 million UAH
The central bank sold 600,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 17.
